name: @capybearista/opencode-ram-monitor
description: Monitor RAM usage of OpenCode sessions
author: capyBearista <capybearista@gmail.com>

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc --project tsconfig.build.json --emitDeclarationOnly && bun build src/index.ts --outdir=dist --target=bun --external '@opentui/*' --external 'solid-js' --external 'tree-sitter*' && [ -f dist/src/index.js ] && mv dist/src/index.js dist/index.js && rm -rf dist/src || true
